title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who acts as a pharmacy benefit manager in this State without first being registered pursuant to this chapter shall be subject to a fine of $500 for each violation.
bodyHtml: [§431S-5]  Penalty.  Any person who acts as a pharmacy benefit manager in this State without first being registered pursuant to this chapter shall be subject to a fine of $500 for each violation. [L 2017, c 44, pt of §2]
